items.title: Illumina (ILMN) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift As Analysts Debate Growth Outlook
items.summary: Illumina’s updated valuation workpoints to a fair value of US$261.45 per share, compared with the previous US$248.90, giving you a fresh reference point for the current analyst debate. That debate is wide, with ratings now running from Sell to Buy and price targets stretching from more cautious views to the mid to high US$200s and low US$300s, as firms weigh potential upside from clinical demand and AI themes against execution and valuation risks. items.title: Missed Illumina's 76% Run? Here Is What Holders Saw
items.summary: If Illumina sat on your watchlist instead of in your portfolio, the past year might feel like a missed shot. Investors who held Illumina over the past year are up 76.2%, including dividends. That outcome arrived alongside headlines about NovaSeq X uptake, clinical sequencing demand, and moves into multiomics. items.title: Illumina (ILMN) Unveils Duplex Sequencing Workflow For MRD Research
items.summary: Illumina (NasdaqGS:ILMN) has expanded its molecular residual disease research portfolio with an ultrasensitive duplex sequencing workflow for circulating tumor DNA. The company introduced an industry-level duplex sequencing approach designed to increase sensitivity in detecting molecular residual disease signals in cancer research.
